environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. No application-layer inspection. Flask app runs as container on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/app-task-role. The /api/v2/users/search endpoint is exposed to internal microservices for directory lookups.

config.load_balancer: NLB, TCP listener on port 443 forwarding to target group on 8080
config.network: Private subnet, SG allows 10.0.0.0/8 on TCP/8080
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Python 3.11, sqlite3 module available
config.database: Local SQLite file on ephemeral storage
